motions.item_title: Authority to move into closed meeting
motions.text: That the Council of the City of Guelph now hold a meeting that is closed to the public, pursuant to The Municipal Act, to consider: 1242-1270 Gordon Street and 9 Valley Road - Ontario Land Tribunal Update - 2026-373 As per Section 239(2)(e) and (f) of the Municipal Act, regarding litigation or potential litigation, including matters before administrative tribunals, affecting the municipality or local board and advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege, including communications necessary for that purpose. Potential Land Acquisition As per Section 239(2)(c), (f) and (k) of the Municipal Act, regarding a proposed or pending acquisition or disposition of land by the municipality or local board, advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege, including communications necessary for that purpose and a position, plan, procedure, criteria or instruction to be applied to any negotiations carried on or to be carried on by or on behalf of the municipality or local board.
motions.text_html:
That the Council of the City of Guelph now hold a meeting that is closed to the public, pursuant to The Municipal Act, to consider:

1242-1270 Gordon Street and 9 Valley Road - Ontario Land Tribunal Update - 2026-373
As per Section 239(2)(e) and (f) of the Municipal Act, regarding litigation or potential litigation, including matters before administrative tribunals, affecting the municipality or local board and advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege, including communications necessary for that purpose.

Potential Land Acquisition
As per Section 239(2)(c), (f) and (k) of the Municipal Act, regarding a proposed or pending acquisition or disposition of land by the municipality or local board, advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege, including communications necessary for that purpose and a position, plan, procedure, criteria or instruction to be applied to any negotiations carried on or to be carried on by or on behalf of the municipality or local board.

motions.item_title: 19 Dublin Street South - Notice of Intention to Designate - 2026-272
motions.text: That the City Clerk be authorized to publish and serve notice of intention to designate 19 Dublin Street South pursuant to Part IV, Section 29 of the Ontario Heritage Act. That the designation by-law be brought before Council if no objections are received within the thirty (30) day objection period.
motions.text_html:
1. That the City Clerk be authorized to publish and serve notice of intention to designate 19 Dublin Street South pursuant to Part IV, Section 29 of the Ontario Heritage Act.
  2. That the designation by-law be brought before Council if no objections are received within the thirty (30) day objection period.

motions.item_title: Public Meeting and Decision Report for Proposed Rental Replacement By-law and Enabling Official Plan Amendment - 2026-351
motions.text: That the Public Meeting and Decision Report for Proposed Rental Replacement By-law and Enabling Official Plan Amendment as outlined in report 2026-351, dated July 14, 2026, be approved. That the draft Rental Replacement Bylaw Number (2026) – 21270, included as Attachment – 1, of the Public Meeting and Decision Report for Proposed Rental Replacement By-law and Enabling Official Plan Amendment report 2026-351 dated July 14, 2026 be approved. That the draft Official Plan Amendment Bylaw Number (2026) – 21271, included as Attachment – 2, of the Public Meeting and Decision Report for Proposed Rental Replacement By-law and Enabling Official Plan Amendment report 2026-351 dated July 14, 2026 be approved. That the draft Demolition Control By-law Amendment Bylaw Number (2026) – 21272, included as Attachment – 3, of the Public Meeting and Decision Report for Proposed Rental Replacement By-law and Enabling Official Plan Amendment report 2026-351 dated July 14, 2026 be approved. That in accordance with the Planning Act, City Council has determined that no further public notice is required related to the attached Official Plan Amendment, Demolition Control By-law Amendment and the Rental Replacement By-law.
motions.text_html:
1. That the Public Meeting and Decision Report for Proposed Rental Replacement By-law and Enabling Official Plan Amendment as outlined in report 2026-351, dated July 14, 2026, be approved.
  2. That the draft Rental Replacement Bylaw Number (2026) – 21270, included as Attachment – 1, of the Public Meeting and Decision Report for Proposed Rental Replacement By-law and Enabling Official Plan Amendment report 2026-351 dated July 14, 2026 be approved.
  3. That the draft Official Plan Amendment Bylaw Number (2026) – 21271, included as Attachment – 2, of the Public Meeting and Decision Report for Proposed Rental Replacement By-law and Enabling Official Plan Amendment report 2026-351 dated July 14, 2026 be approved.
  4. That the draft Demolition Control By-law Amendment Bylaw Number (2026) – 21272, included as Attachment – 3, of the Public Meeting and Decision Report for Proposed Rental Replacement By-law and Enabling Official Plan Amendment report 2026-351 dated July 14, 2026 be approved.
  5. That in accordance with the Planning Act, City Council has determined that no further public notice is required related to the attached Official Plan Amendment, Demolition Control By-law Amendment and the Rental Replacement By-law.
